Bill.BriefDescription: Reducing the cost of transportation projects by providing a sales and use tax exemption.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reducing the cost of transportation projects byproviding a sales and use tax exemption; adding a new section tochapter 82.08 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of goodsand services for the capital construction of a transportation project.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to the useof goods and services for the capital construction of a transportationproject.
